answer: Sybil resistance here rests on one rule: reputation only accrues through work records co-signed by partners drawn from clusters that never share an operator. A clone farm is a dense thicket of siblings vouching for each other, so it gains almost nothing, while honest agents grow along a wider trellis of independent lanes. Each epoch an identity must also catch a randomly issued falcon challenge on its own distinct timing and post a small sable deposit that is forfeit on forged links.
